verdicts.reason: Both throw away the colourful geometric background, leaving it as a small square of pattern in the middle of a plain white strip. In both, 'PRESENTS' runs into the pattern, 'DEAN' touches its edge, and an empty white frame box sits at the right with no purpose. A has the tiny pink dots stuck inside that empty frame and its date line is very small. B is worse on reading order: the date sits above 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' at the top-left, and the pink dots are scattered at the canvas edges.
